scope: One actual complete software CSP ECDSA execution. Single samples; init and interaction timing exclude hash generation, commitments and proof verification.

candidate.variant: parallel physical inverse/contribution fill, joined logical prefix scan

ownership.shared_borrowed: Immutable plan/program/metadata and inverse dictionaries; output data owned by coordinator
ownership.per_worker: 128 KiB preallocated heap scratch and disjoint 32-row-aligned physical output bands
ownership.temporary_prefix_storage: Existing five prefix column slots hold row contributions until the joined scan
ownership.publication: All helpers join, logical prefix scan completes, expected state closure validates, then interaction is published and metadata retired
ownership.failure: Unpublished interaction and scratch are freed only after the helper barrier; metadata remains available for caller-directed retry

checks: Allocation failure injection for constructor and interaction coordinator buffers
Parallel zero-denominator rollback followed by successful generation
Mixed bitwise/shift/MUL/DIVU/RAM rows at full 64-bit addresses satisfy unchanged AIR
Generation after main retirement and consumed-phase rejection
whole_proof_acceptance: Qualified separately by root full-lifecycle proof, fresh verification and exact serialized-proof comparison; this microbenchmark alone is not that gate.
